items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 29 at 12:55PM PDT until September 30 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected due to the combination
of high tides and elevated surf.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated surf of 2-4 feet on south and
southwest-beaches. Morning high tides are expected to peak
between 6.9 and 7.1 feet between 11 AM and noon on Wednesday.
These tide predictions have been corrected to reflect current
trends in observed tide observations.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 29 at 1:59PM PDT until September 29 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...East Santa Barbara Channel from Pt. Conception to Pt.
Mugu CA including Santa Cruz Island and Inner waters from
Point Mugu to San Mateo Pt. CA including Santa Catalina and
Anacapa Islands.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
